name: data
title: Data analysis - profile, pre-register, analyze reproducibly, validate
titleAr: تحليل بيانات — توصيف ← تسجيل الفرضيات ← تحليل قابل للإعادة ← تحقق
description: For analysts working on datasets (CSV, JSON, Parquet, SQLite, logs) in the project or at a path named in the task. Data is profiled first, metrics and hypotheses are fixed before results are seen, the analysis is one re-runnable script, and an independent reviewer re-executes it and re-derives the headline numbers. Source data is never modified.

stages.title: Profile & pre-register
stages.prompt:
Analysis question: {TASK}

Project root: {PROJECT}. Locate the datasets the question needs (in the project or at the path the task names) and detect the analysis tools already installed (`python --version` plus pandas/polars/scipy/statsmodels imports, `duckdb --version`, `sqlite3 --version`, `jq --version`, csvkit); never install anything. Profile each dataset read-only: row and column counts, types, null and duplicate rates, distinct counts, ranges and obvious anomalies, with the command behind every figure. Then pre-register the analysis before looking at any result: metric definitions (ID, formula, unit, filters), hypotheses H1..Hn with the test or comparison, the effect size that would matter and the significance level, planned cleaning rules, and known limitations (sampling, bias, missing data). Write .workbench/artifacts/data-profile.md with those sections.
stages.gateQuestion: Approve the metric definitions and hypotheses before analysis?
stages.gateQuestionAr: توافق على تعريف المقاييس والفرضيات قبل التحليل؟
done: data-profile.md lists each dataset with row/column counts, types, null and duplicate rates and the command behind every figure
data-profile.md records which analysis tools are available or NOT AVAILABLE
data-profile.md pre-registers metric definitions, hypotheses with their tests and decision thresholds, and cleaning rules
No source data file was modified

stages.title: Reproducible analysis
stages.prompt:
Analysis question: {TASK}

Project root: {PROJECT}. Execute the pre-registered plan in .workbench/artifacts/data-profile.md; if .workbench/artifacts/review.md exists from an earlier round, fix everything it lists first. Put the whole analysis in one re-runnable script under .workbench/artifacts/data/ (Python, SQL for DuckDB/SQLite, or Node - whichever is available) that reads the source data read-only and writes its outputs next to itself, then run it. Write report.md per your role contract and add `## Reproduce` (the exact command), `## Cleaning log` (every filter or transformation with rows affected) and per-hypothesis results (SUPPORTED / NOT SUPPORTED / INCONCLUSIVE with the test used, assumptions checked, effect size and confidence interval). Numbers table columns: ID, Metric, Value, Unit, n, Uncertainty (CI or range), Source (script output). List and justify every deviation from the pre-registration; never report a correlation as a cause.
done: A re-runnable analysis script exists under .workbench/artifacts/data/ and report.md gives the exact command to reproduce it
report.md contains a Cleaning log with rows affected by every filter or transformation
Every hypothesis has a result with test, effect size and uncertainty, and every number appears in the Numbers table
Deviations from the pre-registered plan are listed with a reason
Recommendations are ranked with impact, effort, risk and a first concrete step

stages.title: Re-execute & validate
stages.prompt: Validate the data analysis for the project at {PROJECT}. Re-run the Reproduce command from .workbench/artifacts/report.md from a clean state and compare every output with the Numbers table. Independently recompute at least three headline numbers with a different method or tool (for example a SQL query versus the script). Check the statistics: the test fits the data, assumptions were checked, multiple comparisons are handled, sample sizes are stated, there is no causal language without a causal design, and results follow the pre-registration in data-profile.md or deviations are justified. Confirm no source data file changed. Write review.md with the Verdict line, a re-run comparison table and required fixes. Do not modify any project file. Lead your reply with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL.
stages.gateQuestion: The analysis was re-executed and validated - accept it?
stages.gateQuestionAr: التحليل اتعاد تشغيله واتأكدنا منه — نعتمده؟
done: review.md exists with an explicit Verdict line
review.md contains a re-run comparison table for the Numbers table and at least three independently recomputed headline numbers
review.md assesses the statistical claims against the pre-registration
